## Turquoise Thunder — *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic* (G4)

Turquoise Thunder is a lightly colored turquoise/mint Pegasus mare with a coral-pink mane and tail, blue eyes, and a cloud-and-lightning-bolt cutie mark. She is a background attendee at the Rainbow Falls flying trials, rather than a named member of Rainbow Dash’s relay team. The [Pegasus character index](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Pegasus_ponies) records her first appearance in *Rainbow Falls* (S4E10, approximately 04:24 in its episode index) and subsequent sightings.

**Name and identity:** “Turquoise Thunder” is used by fan-maintained character and [cutie-mark catalogs](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_cutie_marks). I could not verify an official Hasbro name, an original naming announcement, or who coined it. She shares a common background-pony design with White Lightning, Blueberry Cloud, and Jetstream; that does **not** establish that they are the same pony. No verified disguise, alter ego, or alternate identity.

**Speaking status:** No individually attributable spoken dialogue or credited voice actor could be verified.

## Important moments

These are **recognizable sightings**, not independently developed story beats; no character-defining dialogue or decision is documented.

1. **At the relay qualifiers — “Rainbow Falls” (S4E10):** She appears among the pegasi gathered for the Equestria Games tryouts, the setting of Rainbow Dash’s loyalty dilemma. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5Vfb3EgzETQ) — precise scene timestamp unavailable.
2. **At the Crystal Empire — “Equestria Games” (S4E24):** Her background return places her at the Games themselves, following the trials. [Full episode from the My Little Pony channel](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=w5tPOH4MBu4) — scene timestamp unavailable.
3. **During the winter storyline — “Tanks for the Memories” (S5E5):** She is cataloged among the background ponies appearing in the episode about Rainbow Dash and Tank’s hibernation. [Licensed episode stream](https://tubitv.com/tv-shows/200165259/s05-e05-tanks-for-the-memories) — scene timestamp unavailable.

**Images:** No character-specific still or artwork page could be independently verified with reliable attribution, so no lookalike image is presented as her. The character is part of the show’s G4 television continuity; the *name’s* official status remains unverified.
